title: Dinner Lady Watermelon Slices E-Liquid 10ml
description: Indulge in a refreshing vape with the fruity Dinner Lady Watermelon Slices E-Liquid 10ml. Each inhale and exha le offer the sweet invigorating taste of freshly sliced Watermelon. The fresh, mellow sweetness of watermelon gets the hard candy treatment in this mouth-watering vape from Dinner Lady . With the added layer of a gentle interplay between sweet and sour . Make this a great E-Liquid for any vaper looking for the ultimate refreshing vape experience . The 70% Vegetable Glycerine, and 30% Propylene Glycol formula make this E-Liquid ideal for sub-ohm vaping, producing mighty clouds on top of fantastic flavour and a smooth, comfortable, throat hit. Sub-ohm vaping generally requires the use of high-powered vape kits, including pod vape kits and pod mods with higher power outputs, some pen vape kits and advanced kits .
